meta.title: Imukan n Umezruy d Temdinin i Yesɛan Isem-is
meta.desc: Seg Carthagène ar Ibiza, seg Kerkouane ar Trasimène, armi d Hannibal (Missouri) akked Cartagena de Indias : imukan anda mazal-aɣ nettawi deg iḍaren n Qarṭaǧ.
hero.title: Deg Iḍaren n Qarṭaǧ
hero.lede: Seg Carthagène ar Ibiza, seg Kerkouane ar Trasimène — armi d Missouri.
hero.caption: Lesswaṛ apunik n Carthagène (Qart Hadasht), Spania
liveNames: Temdinin i yesɛan isem-agi i d-ibeggnen
places.cartagena.name: Carthagène
places.cartagena.text: Tesnulfa-tt-id Hasdrubal Ucebḥan s yisem-nni n Qarṭaǧ : Qart Hadasht, « Tamdint Tamaynut ». Tamanaɣt n At Barca di Hispania, qrib i tɣerwa n lfeṣṣa ssɛayant, tella d lqaɛa n Hannibal uqbel Italya. Scipion yeṭṭef-itt di 209 uq.Ɛ. ; lesswaṛ-is apunik yettwazuret ass-a.
places.cartagena.note: Yal Ctamber : tameɣra n « Iqarṭaǧiyen d Iṛumaniyen »
places.sagunto.name: Sagonte
places.sagunto.text: Tamdakelt n Ṛuma, Hannibal issiddi-tt tmanya n wayyuren (Tite-Live) : aɣelluy-is yesnulfa-d amennuɣ apunik wis sin.
places.ibiza.name: Ibiza (Ebusus)
places.ibiza.alt: Iẓekwan n Puig des Molins, Ibiza
places.ibiza.text: Tamdint tapunikt n Ybšm (Ibossim) ; iẓekwan n Puig des Molins ḥerzen-d uḍan n iẓekwan.
places.gadir.name: Cadix (Gadir)
places.gadir.text: Amkan n ttjara afiniqi, amdakel n Qarṭaǧ, tawwurt ɣer Atlantique. Uqbel ad yeddu ɣer Italya, Hannibal iṣafer ɣer dinna iwakken ad ixdem tɛahedin-is deg uxxam n ssjada n Melqart (Tite-Live).
places.akra.name: Akra Leuké
places.akra.alt: Hamilcar Barca, win i d-yesnulfan Akra Leuké
places.akra.text: « Tiɣalt Tamellalt », tesnulfa-tt-id Hamilcar Barca deg tazwara n uṭṭef n At Barca i Hispania ; tettwaḍeg aṭas di Alicante, war tseḥqiqt.
places.byrsa.name: Byrsa, Qarṭaǧ
places.byrsa.text: Lqasba n tmacahutt n Élissa akked tɣerci n ufunas. Ɣef idis-is, « lḥara n Hannibal » : ixxamen ipunikiyen n lqern wis 2 uq.Ɛ.
places.kerkouane.name: Kerkouane
places.kerkouane.text: Yiwet n tmdint tapunikt kan i d-yufraren s telqayt, teǧǧa-tt deg lqern wis 3 uq.Ɛ. ur tt-id-tbna Ṛuma : iberdan, ixxamen d iwenḍasen n usiraf.
places.tophet.name: Tofet
places.tophet.alt: Iẓra n usekkil n tofet n Salammbô
places.tophet.text: Amkan n lɛibada n Baal Hammon akked Tanit, yettwaseqdac seg lqern wis 8 armi d 146 uq.Ɛ. : uḍan n lǧrar d yiẓra n usekkil, i ur fhimen akk ɣef lmeɛna-nsen.
places.ports.name: Ibeḥriyen Ipunikiyen
places.ports.text: Abeḥri amgallal yeṭṭef lbabuṛat n umennuɣ — 220 n yimukan akken i d-yeqqaṛ Appien — akked webeḥri uzirig, i ttjara.
places.bardo.name: Amuzgan n Bardo
places.bardo.text: Iẓra n usekkil n tofet, lqnaɛ, ccbaḥa d tɛuwwaḍin : yiwet seg tjemmaɛin tipunikiyen timeqqranin deg umaḍal.
places.zama.name: Zama
places.zama.alt: Umennuɣ n Zama, tira n Cornelis Cort
places.zama.text: Scipion ineɣ dinna Hannibal. Amḍiq-ines d tidet mazal-it d asteqsi, deg ugafa alɣarbi n Tunisia n wass-a.
places.trasimene.name: Aɣeẓdis n Trasimène
places.trasimene.text: Amḍiq n lkamin ameqqran deg umezruy aqdim : aneɣlaf Flaminius yemmut dinna akked ca n 15 000 n Iṛumaniyen.
places.cannae.name: Cannes
places.cannae.alt: Amḍiq n umennuɣ n Cannes, Pouilles
places.cannae.text: Aṭṭef n Hannibal s snat tɣuriwin : akken i d-yeqqaṛ Polybe, ca n 70 000 n Iṛumaniyen mmuten dinna.
places.marsala.name: Marsala (Lilybée)
places.marsala.text: Tesnulfa-tt-id deffir uɣelluy n Motyé, lqasba tapunikt n Sicile teqqim zdat Ṛuma armi d 241. Amuzgan-ines isekkan lmeṛkeb n umennuɣ apunik yettwafen di 1971.
names.caption: Main Street — Hannibal, Missouri (Iwunak Idduklen)
names.title: Temdinin yismawen-nsent Hannibal… akked Qarṭaǧ
names.rows.0.val: Isem-is yusa-d seg webrid n waman « Hannibal », i d-isemma di 1800 umeẓri Antonio Soulard i uqayed. D tamdint anda yemɣi Mark Twain.
names.rows.1.val: Yiwet seg temdinin n « Military Tract » yesɛan ismawen n zik, ɣer tama n Troy, Ithaca neɣ Syracuse.
names.rows.2.val: Missouri, Texas, New York, Illinois, Tennessee… ugar n ɛecra n temdinin Amarikaniyen sɛant isem n temdint tapunikt.
names.rows.3.val: Tamdint taklumbit, tesnulfa-tt-id di 1533, isem-is yusa-d seg Carthagène n Spania — syen, ɣer deffir, seg Qart Hadasht.
map.title: Amḍiq Aqarṭaǧi
related.0.title: Qarṭaǧ d Lebḥer Alemmas
related.0.text: Timura, amennuɣ n Hannibal, iberdan n Hannon d Himilcon.
related.1.title: Qarṭaǧ Teddar di Tunisia
related.1.text: Seg yisem n Tefriqt ar lqaɛa n Qarṭaǧ : tiddukla tunisit.
related.2.title: Ssɛaya Tugar i Ṛuma
related.2.text: Acuɣer ssɛaya n Qarṭaǧ tesserɣ ul n Ṛuma.
